TS038 positive-invariants

A branch that negates its condition and carries an else reads backwards; the positive case belongs first.

languages: go javascript odin python rust typescript zig
severity: info
default: on
group: stable

TigerStyle: "Negations are not easy! State invariants positively. When working with lengths and indexes, this form is easy to get right (and understand) [...] This form is harder, and also goes against the grain of how `index` would typically be compared to `length`, for example, in a loop condition."
